content: This paper introduces jiant, an open source toolkit that allows researchers to quickly experiment on a wide array of NLU tasks, using state-of-the-art NLP models, and conduct experiments on probing, transfer learning, and multitask training. jiant supports many state-of-the-art Transformer-based models implemented by Huggingface's Transformers package, as well as non-Transformer models such as BiLSTMs.
